cpu_config_gate.summary: 245 tests; scoped Ruff and diff check pass

gloo_dcp_gate.summary: Both 8-owner persistence modes; 58-batch OFF/ON hashes and 896 rows match; actual peer epoch entry overlapped rank0 paused queued56; completed before A measured window

authorization_and_gates.native_perf_authorization: goal-objective.md attachment 4e1e23cb-a372-4d58-8d0d-2cdecd6b7298; existing allocation, native TPS only; no installs/downloads/environment setup/new allocation/source changes

common_measurement_contract.observations: Physical input TPS and globally supervised-target TPS remain separate; per-GPU values are global rates divided by eight.
common_measurement_contract.per_update_scope: Native Profiler.step host interval series per rank; no per-update synchronization; the final interval includes the end-boundary drain. Overlapping scopes are not summed.
common_measurement_contract.timer_scope: Full eight-rank window: max rank end monotonic timestamp minus min rank start timestamp; boundary CUDA drains included. Normal MDS input, transfers, compute, communication, optimizer and lightweight logging included; initialization/cold compilation, 10 warmup updates, and teardown excluded.

comparison.interpretation: One matched unprofiled pair only. The observed A/B difference is provisional; within-run step spread is not a run-to-run noise estimate, and no confidence interval or speedup claim is established.
comparison.paired_order: A depth0 then B depth32; serial; no repetition

compiler_and_settling_evidence.deep_gemm_startup_notice: The preserved A launcher log reports 39 DeepGEMM kernels compiled during startup warmup and says cache misses during training may compile. This is a capability notice, not evidence that a compilation occurred in the measured window.
compiler_and_settling_evidence.launcher_log_review: Targeted existing-log search found torch.compile loss/block startup messages before “Training starts at step 1”. No compile/NVCC/JIT marker was found after startup in the searched launcher and structured logs.
compiler_and_settling_evidence.limits: The logs do not prove absence of asynchronous or otherwise unlogged JIT work in updates 11–20 because compiler observation and guard receipts were disabled. No direct evidence of an in-window compile or continuing settling was found; step16 cause remains unassigned.
compiler_and_settling_evidence.rank_measurement_sidecars: No compiler guard/cache observation fields are present; the runner compiler observer and DeepGEMM guard are disabled.

targeted_update_16_review.disposition: Retained. All eight B ranks show the same step16 interval of about 17.626 s; A step16 is about 14.925 s. This is an update-level outlier relative to B’s 13.304–15.018 s per-rank ordinary interval range. It coincides with the same 56-batch epoch boundary in both variants, but no cause is established.

measured_window_review.uncertainty: One A/B pair only. Per-update variation describes within-run spread and is not a run-to-run noise estimate. No repeat, confidence interval, or general speedup claim.

preserved_controller_start_failure.outcome: Outer nohup controller did not survive exec_command return; no runner attempt, torchrun, or GPU work started. Successful A used the separate setsid controller log/PID recorded in its run record.
